text:
liz: Quick sync — final checklist for the partner storefront cutover and press sequencing. Can folks confirm owners for the items below?
omar: I can own AWS Marketplace asset push and the billing SKU mapping. :thumbsup:
sophia: I'll take the landing page content freeze and localization handoff. ETA EOD tomorrow. :calendar:
ram: SI integration docs and sample terraform snippets are on me. Need a couple hours to tidy.
liz: Awesome. Headline items: 1) press embargo window, 2) assets (logos/screens), 3) landing page freeze, 4) marketplace listings, 5) SI integration checklist, 6) cutover runbook and rollback.
sophia: For embargo — legal says we need a 48h window for partner approvals. Can we align press send at 2025-06-12 16:00 PT?
omar: 2025-06-12 works if AWS listing is live by 14:00 PT. We still need the SKU validation step.
ram: SI docs need a sample connector config. I'll drop this gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/si-connector-sample — will update with env var notes.
liz: Landing page freeze: sophia, please freeze by 06/11 23:59 PT. Any outstanding copy change requests after that go to append-only and will be handled with banners.
sophia: noted. Also adding a small banner for known limitations (quantization differences) for early adopters.
omar: Marketplace checklist (short):
```
- package validation (manifest.json)
- AML test deploy in staging
- billing SKU map verified
- vendor contact confirmation
```
ram: For cutover runbook, propose this window: 06/12 12:00–15:00 PT. Steps: prechecks, asset push, DNS swap, smoke tests, press send. If failure, rollback to previous DNS and disable listing.
liz: Can deploy-bot run the smoke after asset push?@deploy-bot any constraints?
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window allowed. I can run a post-push smoke-run (smoke.sh) and post results to this thread. Use `deploy-bot run smoke --playbook storefront-cutover`
sophia: Also need the PR owner for blog post. Who's writing the partner quote?
ram: I'll coordinate with SI PM for a joint quote. If we don't get it by 06/10 18:00 PT, we publish without the quote and append later.
omar: Legal signoff on marketplace terms? Who's owner?
liz: Legal already pre-cleared the T&Cs template. I'll loop in @legal-channel after this thread for final stamp — target 06/11.
sophia: Microcopy review done for EN/FR/DE, working on JP. If we miss JP we ship with EN fallback.
ram: Integration smoke test checklist (short): auth ok, sample inference run <500ms p50, logs present in partner SI console, orchestration example works.
omar: Confirming telemetry keys will be rotated post-launch — we'll push a note to partners.
liz: Owners summary: AWS listing & billing -> omar; landing page & localization -> sophia; SI docs & quote -> ram; press coordination & legal -> liz.
sophia: I pushed final assets to the shared drive: https://redwood.com/drive/marketplace-assets (logos + screenshots). Use the latest `assets_v3`.
omar: One last technical: DNS cutover command (ops):
```bash
# switch storefront alias to new S3 bucket
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345 --change-batch file://cutover.json
```
Make sure TTL is low before switch.
ram: Agreed. I'll update the runbook with the exact rollback command.
liz: Great. Last check: press embargo recipients list — sophia can you paste final list here?
sophia: Paste below. Will DM legal for the final attendee list.
sophia: `partners@partnerco.com, press@partnerco.com, partner-press@si.com, redwood-press@redwood.com`
omar: OK. Target timeline recap:
- 06/11 23:59 PT: landing page freeze
- 06/12 12:00–15:00 PT: cutover window
- 06/12 14:00 PT: AWS listing live
- 06/12 16:00 PT: press send (embargo lift)
liz: Perfect. If no objections I'll lock the timeline and create a calendar invite with the runbook link.
sophia: No objections from my side. :eyes:
ram: All good.
omar: Good to go.
liz: Creating invite and tagging owners now. Thanks! :rocket:
